accountDelete.title: Delete Account
accountDelete.body: Deleting your account removes your user from AlgaPSA. If you're on a Solo plan, your account and all its data — clients, tickets, invoices, time entries — will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
accountDelete.appleNote: Note: deleting your account here does NOT automatically cancel your Apple subscription. To stop future charges, open Settings on your iPhone → your name → Subscriptions → AlgaPSA → Cancel Subscription.
accountDelete.confirmMessage: This will permanently delete your user account. If you're on a Solo plan, your account and all its data will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
accountDelete.cancelInstructions: To stop future Apple charges, open Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions and cancel AlgaPSA.
